page_title: BOC 0-1 WER | Bochum v Werder Bremen 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Romano Schmid departs the field of play to be replaced by Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen).
90+1' Here is a change. Derrick Kohn is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
86' Substitution. Felix Passlack makes his way off the pitch and Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) comes on as his replacement.
83' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Matus Bero (Bochum) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
77' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Ibrahima Sissoko and he is replaced by Mats Pannewig (Bochum).
77' Substitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) has come on for Philipp Hofmann.
76' That's the end of the game for Senne Lynen, who is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
76' Substitution. Marvin Ducksch leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
75' The ball is cleared after Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Maximilian Wittek is replaced by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
72' It will be a substitution. Dani de Wit (Bochum) is ready to enter the pitch as Koji Miyoshi walks off.

71' A short pass finds Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
70' Bochum are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
63' A pass from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by Patrick Drewes and the move breaks down.
59' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) whips in a cross from the corner, but Patrick Drewes is well positioned and punches the ball away.

59' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Werder Bremen have a corner.
57' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) replacing Justin Njinmah.

56' 0 - 1 The ball was swung towards the box by Marvin Ducksch from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Jens Stage (Werder Bremen), who planted a powerful header into the roof of the net to make the score 0:1.
55' There's an opportunity for Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
55' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
50' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
49' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.
49' Felix Passlack (Bochum) will deliver the corner kick.

48' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bochum force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Felix Brych blows for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The referee blows his whistle after Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
43' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
40' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
40' Felix Passlack (Bochum) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
39' A corner kick by Bochum is thwarted by the well prepared Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen).

39' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
29' The game has begun to heat up. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
27' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

26' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Michael Zetterer thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
25' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
25' Unlucky! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies just wide of the left post.

21' Patrick Drewes makes a brilliant save! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!

14' What an opportunity! Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
13' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

12' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
10' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

7' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bochum are taking a throw-in.
6' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Bochum will have an opportunity.
4' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) commits a rough foul. Felix Brych stops the game and makes a call.
2' The cross into the penalty area from Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Felix Brych is the one to supervise the game today.
